policy: External papers are source-reported until independently reviewed by the Commons. Each update must state both consequence and non-consequence.

updates.title: Distribution of Singular Data Generated by Compact Forced Navier-Stokes Blowup
updates.reported_result: For fixed viscosity/time horizon on T^3, smooth forces producing classical breakdown from rest are dense in the inherited time-integrated spatial H^s topology iff s<1/2, with further fixed-initial-velocity/mixed-norm/interior results.
does_not_establish: classification of singular initial velocities for one prescribed force
updates.frontier_effect: Upgrades varying-force abundance from speculation to a concrete externally reported theorem; sharpens which stability/genericity questions remain genuinely open.

updates.title: Singular Forces on the Whole Space: Sobolev Density Thresholds and Energy Approximation
updates.reported_result: On R^3, singular forces are reported dense in relative L1_t H^s_x iff s<1/2 and in relative L2_t H^s_x iff s<-1/2, preserving fixed smooth initial velocity and approximating energy/dissipation.
updates.frontier_effect: Supplies concrete force-space thresholds and numerical/energy approximation targets while leaving fixed-force and unforced questions open.
